environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in a public subnet. The NLB forwards TCP/8080 directly to the instance. Security group allows inbound 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy layers. The application runs as a systemd service under the 'appuser' account. Instance is in a VPC with default NACL (allow all). No AWS WAF is associated with the NLB (WAF cannot be attached to NLB). Route53 A-record alias points directly to the NLB.

config.waf: none (NLB does not support WAF association)
